name: Priya Nair
quote: I booked a voice call close to 11pm after a fight at home. I was switching between Hindi and English, and the advisor just let me talk. No ‘think positive’ lecture. I could sleep after that.

name: Rohan Mehta
quote: I don’t usually talk about this stuff. Chat was easier than a call. We spoke about my parents and the marriage pressure, not some generic advice. Paid ₹499 on UPI and it went through in one shot.

name: Anjali Sharma
quote: Got a same-evening slot, which I needed. The session was kind and private. I’m giving 4 because my first time was already taken, so I had to move it by an hour. Still glad I booked.

name: Karthik Iyer
quote: My partner is in Singapore and every WhatsApp reply was turning into a fight. One 45-minute call helped me slow down. Straight talk, no drama.

name: Fatima Qureshi
quote: After night duty the family calls start, always about a rishta. I didn’t have the energy to explain this to friends. I spoke mostly in Hindi. Felt respected, not rushed.

name: Amit Joshi
quote: We talked about money arguments after marriage. I wanted a quick fix and the advisor kept saying slow down and actually talk, which irritated me at first. Later I realised that was the useful part.

name: Sneha Reddy
quote: Placements and a breakup landed in the same month. I cried in the first ten minutes and nobody told me to wrap it up. They are clear this is not a clinic. That honesty helped.

name: Harpreet Singh
quote: Booked between two site visits. Short call, but I walked out with what I would actually say to my father. I had been postponing that conversation for weeks. Site was simple, no confusion.

name: Meera Krishnan
quote: Video froze once on office wifi. We switched to voice and carried on. Advisor didn’t make it awkward. The talk itself was worth it — I just wouldn’t start on video if the network is weak.

name: Arvind Menon
quote: New city, no friends yet, and I was overthinking someone I met at work. Didn’t want this in the office WhatsApp group. Private chat during lunch felt like a normal conversation.

name: Pooja Patel
quote: I don’t have a circle I can tell everything. In-laws, the quiet at home, all of it. I mixed Gujarati and Hindi and the advisor stayed with me. I booked again the next week.

name: Nikhil Kulkarni
quote: A situationship was messing with my sleep. 30 minutes was a bit short — I should have taken 45. The person was sharp though, and didn’t judge me for being on dating apps.

name: Ishita Banerjee
quote: I talk to people all day for work and still had nobody for this. Family wants a wedding date. I’m not ready. The session helped me decide what I will actually say at home, without sounding angry.

name: Sandeep Yadav
quote: Too many hotel rooms and targets. I was snapping at my wife on the phone. One session, practical, not a lecture. I called her after and the conversation went better.

name: Ayesha Siddiqui
quote: I live with family and I was worried about privacy. Used my own email, paid myself, and the call was quiet enough. Nobody asked for extra personal details I didn’t want to give.

name: Rahul Deshmukh
quote: Work stress was leaking into my relationship. The advisor understood the odd hours. Confirmation email came the next morning, so not a full 5, but the session itself was solid.

name: Kavya Pillai
quote: Inter-caste relationship, and I was panicking before telling my parents. We practised the conversation. I still said it in my own words, but I was less shaky.

name: Imran Shaikh
quote: I only get a short gap between shifts. Chat worked on my phone, and the price was less than the clinics I had checked. Spoke in Hindi. That mattered.
